caption: The drawing features a single metallic pitcher with a large, ornate handle and a domed lid topped by a decorative finial. The pitcher has a wide, rounded base that narrows slightly as it rises, and it features horizontal banding near the base and just below the lid. The handle is large, sweeping, and curved with a small inward curl at the end, and is attached near the top and bottom of the body. Opposite the handle is a short, wide spout extending horizontally. The surface of the pitcher is shaded in tones of gray to represent its metallic appearance, with highlights and shadows suggesting cylindrical volume and shine. The entire pitcher is centered within a rectangular border, and the background is plain, with a light beige color. In the lower right corner of the border, there is a handwritten signature "Charles Cullen."
title: Pewter Tankard
